CLS-COMPLIANCE.title: Document belongs to the Compliance archive
CLS-COMPLIANCE.explanation: The classifier identified the file as import VAT evidence (an invoice with a customs declaration attached). Tax evidence of this class must be filed in the Compliance archive, so the Finance archive rejected it.
CLS-COMPLIANCE.remedy: Get upload access to the Compliance archive and re-upload the same file there.

VAL-VAT-MISSING.title: Supplier VAT id missing
VAL-VAT-MISSING.explanation: The invoice has no supplier VAT id, which the Finance archive requires for tax records.
VAL-VAT-MISSING.remedy: Add the supplier VAT id to the invoice metadata and re-upload it to Finance.

SYS-ARCHIVE-UNAVAILABLE.title: Archive storage unavailable
SYS-ARCHIVE-UNAVAILABLE.explanation: The archive storage did not accept the write during ingestion. This is a platform fault, not a problem with the file.
SYS-ARCHIVE-UNAVAILABLE.remedy: The platform team investigates and re-runs the ingestion. No user action needed.
